input.text: The periodic table organises 118 known chemical elements by atomic number, electron configuration, and recurring chemical properties. Elements in the same group share similar chemical behaviour because they have the same number of valence electrons. Dmitri Mendeleev published the first widely recognised periodic table in 1869, correctly predicting the properties of several undiscovered elements.
